connector.name: Epwforge MCP
connector.registryDescription: EPW/DDY weather files - TMY/AMY/CMIP6 morphing, UHI, events, smoke. 3 of 4 tools anon-free.
connector.summary: Hosted at epwforge.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package epwforge-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the guzz-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional — only required for generate_weather_file. Other tools (find_station, analyze_weather, chart_weather) work anonymously. Bearer EPWForge API key (sk_live_...) from https://epwforge.com/account, OR OAuth via the 'Add to Claude' flow.

env.name: EPWFORGE_API_KEY
env.description: EPWForge API key — only required for generate_weather_file. Find/analyze/chart tools work without it. Generate a free key (any tier) at https://epwforge.com/account.
